news.title: Trump cancels planned attack on Iran, saying he reached an agreement over the 'perimeters of a deal'
news.summary: The U.S. president said Iran and its regional neighbors asked the U.N. to hold off on attacks after 'the perimeters of a deal has been agreed to'

news.title: Why flights are so expensive and will likely stay that way
news.summary: Airlines are paying billions of dollars more in fuel costs this year. The cost of fuel is expected to rise by as much as $1.5 trillion over the next 15 years.

news.title: Investors scored on Iran war's oil market boom. Staying long the trade will get trickier
news.summary: Oil price volatility caused by U.S.-Iran war created big market winners. For buy-and-hold investors, there are better long-term energy themes to monitor.

news.title: As Americans go direct with GLP-1 prescriptions, Walmart, Costco, Amazon will be big weight-loss winners
news.summary: As Americans are encouraged to go direct with weight-loss drug prescriptions, retail pharmacy chains are poised to win big. Retail pharmacies are expected to benefit from the trend.

news.title: An exam leak in India exposed a Gen Z jobs crisis that goes much deeper
news.summary: The leak of key exam papers was the trigger for the recent student protest in India. Rising unemployment is the real fuel angering Gen Z in the country.

news.title: My ex-husband’s sister died — so why is Fidelity asking me for her death certificate?
news.summary: “Part of me jokes that paying for a death certificate would be like buying a lottery ticket,” he says. “I’m not sure I’d be able to afford it.”

news.title: S&P 500 profit growth is getting even wilder as Amazon makes its mark
news.summary: Amazon is the latest Big Tech company to report abnormally large earnings growth. The growth is due to paper gains on Anthropic investments. Amazon is also the latest big tech company to post abnormally big profits.

news.title: If Social Security’s funding crisis is the elephant in the room, this is the mouse everyone has overlooked. You have been warned.
news.summary: Delaying Social Security until 70 results in an increased monthly payment. “That comes with proportionally higher cost-of-living adjustments,” he says.

news.title: ‘We have always been civil’: My sister refuses to replace me as executor. Can I step down before she dies?
news.summary: “I haven’t seen my sister since our mother’s funeral more than 20 years ago,” she says.

news.title: How Apple’s cheap MacBook Neo sparked a war in budget laptops
